metadata.article_title: Execution of decree or order by Court to which it is sent.

article.title: Execution of decree or order by Court to which it is sent.
article.content:
8Execution of decree or order by Court to which it is sent.

Order 21, Rule 8
Where such copies are so filed, the decree or order may, if the Court to which it is sent is the District Court, be executed by such Court or be transferred for execution to any subordinate Court of competent jurisdiction.
